logic_errors.title: A partial readback-record transaction permanently prevents read-only reconciliation
logic_errors.detail: readSaved derives immutable readback/verification filenames from the journal event count. It writes raw readback first, verification second, and only then records the outcome transition. If the raw file was created but its write/fsync fails, or raw persistence succeeds and verification persistence fails, the journal remains VERIFYING. The store correctly fails closed for that process. A new CompletionEngine clears that process-local store latch, but reconcile does not append a new VERIFYING event when the journal is already VERIFYING. It therefore selects exactly the same filename and attempts wx creation over the surviving readback artifact. EEXIST poisons the new store again. Subsequent read-only reconciliation cannot recover even after storage service is restored. A process crash between these writes has the same deterministic filename collision. The operation and account remain unresolved/circuit-blocked without manual alteration of immutable records. This is a recovery/liveness defect, not evidence of a duplicate portal mutation or an exposed live route.
logic_errors.reproduction: Executed the actual pinned engine, record store, journal, evidence and fixture code through Node VM modules with an entirely in-memory artifact filesystem. Injected one EIO on verification-record open after raw readback persistence: commit rejected with COMPLETION_STORAGE_FAILED_CLOSED; a fresh engine's reconcile rejected with EEXIST on operation-readback-000000000010.json; journal stayed VERIFYING and submit count stayed exactly one. Separately injected a partial raw readback write followed by EIO: the same fresh-engine EEXIST failure occurred. Each probe captured again read-only, but could not persist a new observation. Baseline verification and the repaired post-VERIFIED directory-enumeration failure probe both succeeded.
logic_errors.recommendation: Give each read-only capture attempt a fresh durable/reserved identity independent of an unchanged VERIFYING event count, or implement an explicit recoverable artifact transaction. Preserve existing and partial artifacts as audit material; do not overwrite them or treat them as mutation-retry permission. Permit a fresh read-only capture/outcome after a partial artifact transaction. Add restart regressions for interruption after raw-file creation, after raw fsync, after verification-file creation, and before outcome transition; assert successful later reconciliation and exactly one submit/upload.

limitations: Verdict is an assessment-only candidate review and fails on FINAL-RECOVERY-001. It is not approval to replace the existing release, deploy, enroll an agent, submit Update Task, upload evidence, or complete any live PES task.

Before and after actual source review/probes, independently hashed all 74 manifest file entries and recomputed SHA256 of the compact sorted-key JSON files array. Both aggregate identities matched the expected sourceSetSha256 and all entry hashes matched. This is not a raw manifest-file hash. Prior completion-spec-review.json and completion-engine-review.json were read as historical findings, not substituted for code inspection.

Inspected actual completion engine, policy, evidence decoder/store, journal, verification, notifications, portal driver/coordinator, capability authority, assessment/MCP, main/preload, observer and supporting tests. Source inspection confirms the detail MainContent_TxtGoal guard, independently read department with comparison when explicitly sealed, unchanged posted-field fingerprint, strict MCP optional targetStatus, civil-day cross-view comparisons, bounded PNG decode and guarded post-VERIFIED result/publication enumeration changes. Production selector/postback fidelity is not established by these fixes or the artificial fixture.

Focused in-memory runtime checks accepted a readable PNG and rejected signature-only/truncated/trailing-data/oversized-dimension inputs; allowed Approval/T1 only with Approved targetStatus; accepted Oct/Okt representations of one civil day while rejecting a different day; and retained the original adapter-shaped Store and FIFO fixture discrepancies. They are synthetic/local checks, not authentic evidence intake, real DOM observations or remote backend verification.

The pinned engine baseline and post-VERIFIED listing-error probes returned VERIFIED with exactly one submission/capture; the listing-error case returned stale cache publication. Missing, false and throwing verifySource callbacks blocked before preflight, stage or submission. The two additional artifact-I/O probes reproduced FINAL-RECOVERY-001. Artifact filesystem operations were virtualized in memory; this does not establish real Windows crash/power-loss persistence or ACL behavior. Main tests and build were not rerun here; the parent is responsible for those gates.

Source-trust seam remains explicitly unproven for live use: commit requires the trusted host verifySource callback to return exactly true, and immutable sealed proposals bind evidence/source claims but do not authenticate those claims themselves. No production authoritative-source verifier, enrollment bootstrap, live completion browser transport or saved-view mapper is wired. Future integration must validate original source revisions, task/goal association, evidence provenance/content and secret review rather than promote hypothetical client labels or fixture-enriched observations into trusted facts.

Assessment-only isolation remains intact by inspected code: default enrollment verifier denies; main does not instantiate or dispatch CompletionEngine/PortalCompletionDriver; preload exposes no completion mutation IPC; MCP advertises only list/assessment/get/readiness and always denies commit authorization; the observer has no action callback or human complete button. Existing Sync/login navigation is not a completion dispatcher. Actual supervisor enrollment is NOT MET, and no genuine live canary, semantic approval, server-side attachment hash or Hermes adapter connection is claimed.

Journal ownership is in-process and depends on the host single-instance lock. The implementation expressly does not guarantee Windows directory metadata durability against power loss or protection against a fully compromised same-user account. Attachment verification remains metadata_only where that is what the adapter actually observed.

No live PES calls, application launch, source/configuration/profile edits, commits, packaging or deployments were performed. The only intentional project write is verification/completion-final-review.json. An oversized inline probe was automatically saved by the tool runtime under the Hermes cache/blocked-scripts directory; no project probe/test file was created. Initial probe launcher/linker/mock setup failures were corrected before the successful reported executions; one non-triggering mock injection was corrected and rerun, not counted as a successful fault test.
summary: NOT APPROVED for the final assessment-only delivery gate: pinned source identity is intact and the assessment-only/no-live-write boundary remains closed, but a reproduced immutable-artifact recovery defect prevents read-only reconciliation after partial local I/O or an equivalent crash boundary. Previous reported fixes are present; no live approval is granted.
